SELECT bs.batch_nb, mm.name AS material_name, mk.id, mk.order_number, bs.plant_nb as factory_code, bs.ware_code, bs.area_code, bs.bin_code, mk.material_code, mk.quantity, mk.move_type, mk.sscc_number, mk.cell, mk.type, mk.status, mk.create_by, mk.update_by, mk.create_time, mk.update_time FROM material_kanban mk LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bi_stock where delete_flag='0')bs ON mk.sscc_number = bs.sscc_number LEFT JOIN (SELECT * from md_material where delete_flag='0' )mm ON mk.material_code=mm.code WHERE 1=1 AND mk.delete_flag='0' AND mk.sscc_number in
#{item}

SELECT bs.batch_nb, mm.name AS material_name, mk.id, mk.order_number, mk.factory_code as factory_code, mk.ware_code, mk.area_code, mk.bin_code, mk.material_code, mk.quantity, mk.move_type, mk.sscc_number, mk.cell, mk.type, mk.status, mk.create_by, mk.update_by, mk.create_time, mk.update_time FROM material_kanban mk LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bi_stock where delete_flag = '0') bs ON mk.sscc_number = bs.sscc_number LEFT JOIN (SELECT * from md_material where delete_flag = '0') mm ON mk.material_code = mm.code WHERE mk.delete_flag = 0 and (mk.status = 3 or mk.status = 4) and mk.ware_code like concat('%', #{wareCode}, '%')

SELECT mm.name AS material_name, mk.id, mk.order_number, mk.factory_code as factory_code, mk.ware_code, mk.area_code, mk.bin_code, mk.material_code, mk.quantity, mk.move_type, mk.sscc_number, mk.cell, mk.type, mk.status, mk.create_by, mk.update_by, mk.create_time, mk.update_time FROM material_kanban mk LEFT JOIN (SELECT * from md_material where delete_flag = '0') mm ON mk.material_code = mm.code WHERE mk.delete_flag = 0 and mk.status != -1 and mk.status != 7 and mk.sscc_number like concat('%', #{ssccNb}, '%') limit 1 for update

SELECT bs.batch_nb, mm.name AS material_name, mk.id, mk.order_number, mk.factory_code as factory_code, mk.ware_code, mk.area_code, mk.bin_code, mk.material_code, mk.quantity, mk.move_type, mk.sscc_number, mk.cell, mk.type, mk.status, mk.create_by, mk.update_by, mk.create_time, mk.update_time FROM material_kanban mk LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bi_stock where delete_flag = '0') bs ON mk.sscc_number = bs.sscc_number LEFT JOIN (SELECT * from md_material where delete_flag = '0') mm ON mk.material_code = mm.code WHERE mk.delete_flag = 0 and mk.status = 1 and mk.ware_code like concat('%', #{wareCode}, '%') and mk.sscc_number not in (select sscc_nb from ware_shift where delete_flag = 0 and status = 1)

SELECT mk.id, mm.name AS material_name, mk.order_number, mk.factory_code , mk.ware_code, mk.area_code, mk.bin_code, mk.material_code, mk.quantity, mk.move_type, mk.sscc_number, mk.cell, mk.type, mk.status, mk.create_by, mk.update_by, mk.create_time, mk.update_time, mk.batch_nb, mk.expire_date, mk.bin_down_quantity, ifnull(mk.register_batch,0) register_batch FROM material_kanban mk LEFT JOIN (SELECT * from md_material where delete_flag='0' )mm ON mk.material_code=mm.code WHERE 1=1 AND mk.delete_flag='0'
and mk.order_number like concat('%', #{orderNumber}, '%')
and mk.batch_nb like concat('%', #{batchNb}, '%')
and mk.factory_code like concat('%', #{factoryCode}, '%')
and mk.ware_code like concat('%', #{wareCode}, '%')
and mk.area_code like concat('%', #{areaCode}, '%')
and mk.material_code like concat('%', #{materialCode}, '%')
and mk.sscc_number like concat('%', #{ssccNumber}, '%')
and mk.bin_code like concat('%', #{binCode}, '%')
and mk.cell like concat('%', #{cell}, '%')
and mk.create_by like concat('%', #{createBy}, '%')
and mk.update_by like concat('%', #{updateBy}, '%')
AND mk.type=#{type}
AND mk.status=#{status}
AND mk.create_time >= #{createTimeStart}
AND mk.create_time <= #{createTimeEnd}
AND mk.update_time >= #{updateTimeStart}
AND mk.update_time <= #{updateTimeEnd}
and mk.material_code in (SELECT md_material_type.`code` FROM md_material LEFT JOIN md_material_type ON md_material.material_type_id = md_material_type.id AND md_material.delete_flag = 0 WHERE md_material_type.`code` in
#{item} )
order by mk.update_time desc, mk.create_time desc

SELECT t1.`status`, t2.order_number, t2.material_code, t4.name material_name, t2.sscc_number, t2.batch_nb, t1.quantity, t1.issued_quantity, IFNULL(t2.bin_down_quantity,t2.quantity) pick_quantity, t2.picking_time, t2.quantity received_quantity, t2.received_time, t2.type, t2.parent_id, t3.material_nb return_material_nb, t3.batch_nb return_batch_nb, t3.`status` return_status, t3.quantity return_quantity, t3.create_time return_time, t3.quantity return_received_quantity, t3.received_time return_received_time, IFNULL(t2.bin_down_quantity,t2.quantity)- IFNULL(t3.quantity,0) product_quantity, t5.component_quantity, t6.material_quantity - t5.component_quantity gap_quantity from material_call t1 inner join material_kanban t2 on t1.order_nb = t2.order_number and t1.material_nb = t2.material_code left join material_return t3 on t3.order_number = t2.order_number and t3.sscc_number = t2.sscc_number and t3.material_nb = t2.material_code and t3.`status` > 0 and t3.delete_flag = 0 left join (SELECT * from md_material where delete_flag = '0') t4 ON t2.material_code = t4.code left join (SELECT * from register_bom where delete_flag='0' ) t5 ON t2.order_number=t5.order_number and t2.material_code=t5.bom_component left join (SELECT order_number,material_code,sum(productQuantity) material_quantity from ( SELECT mk.order_number,mk.material_code,mk.sscc_number,IFNULL(mk.bin_down_quantity,mk.quantity)-ifnull(mr.quantity,0) productQuantity from material_kanban mk left join material_return mr on mr.order_number =mk.order_number and mr.sscc_number=mk.sscc_number and mr.material_nb=mk.material_code and mr.delete_flag = 0 and mr.`status` > 0 WHERE mk.`status`=6 and mk.delete_flag = 0 and mk.register_batch=1 ) tt GROUP BY order_number,material_code) t6 on t6.order_number= t2.order_number and t6.material_code=t2.material_code where t2.`status` = 6 and t1.delete_flag = 0 and t2.delete_flag = 0 and t1.register_batch = 1 and t2.register_batch = 1
and t2.order_number like concat('%', #{orderNumber}, '%')
and t2.batch_nb like concat('%', #{batchNb}, '%')
and t2.material_code like concat('%', #{materialCode}, '%')
and t2.sscc_number like concat('%', #{ssccNumber}, '%')
and t2.ware_code like concat('%', #{wareCode}, '%')
AND t2.picking_time >= #{createTimeStart}
AND t2.picking_time <= #{createTimeEnd}
order by order_number, material_code, sscc_number, batch_nb
